title: The base-seven Heraclitus transform: manuscript and reproducible proof package
description:
Version 1.1.0 containing the proposed computer-assisted base-seven coverage proof and the completed exact original-rule rational-epsilon 3/8 equality contract. Includes the manuscript, separate certificate checker and generator, all Lean proof sources and a portable fresh-build workflow. Independent human review remains outstanding. No real-analysis library limsup API theorem or novelty claim is asserted.

MIT for code; CC BY 4.0 for prose and data, by component in LICENSE.
notes: Version 1.1.0 is released on GitHub. No Zenodo upload or new DOI assignment is recorded. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23912682 belongs to historical version 1.0.0 only.
